artboards.title: Option B — Three equal cards, stacked
Option C — Three cards, swipe between

annotations.text:
OPTION A, revised — 2026-08-31

Changed from the version you picked:

1. Header shrunk. 'Your week' drops 32pt to 20pt and the
   eyebrow goes quieter. The greeting was eating ~35% of the
   first screen.

2. Primary team card tightened — smaller scores, the move
   folded into one tappable row instead of its own block.

3. THIRD THING NOW FITS: the swipeable widget deck sits above
   the fold, below your other teams.

Everything is on one screen now. No scrolling to reach any of it.

THE SWIPE, MOVED

Swipe is now on the WIDGETS, not the teams — League Pulse,
the Ledger, Waiver Watch. Your original instinct, applied where
it does not fight the vertical scroll as hard.

Why this is better than swiping teams: the teams need to be
comparable at a glance (that is the whole point of showing
three). Widgets do not — you read them one at a time anyway.

STILL THE SAME RISK, stated plainly: horizontal swipe inside a
vertical scroll is a gesture conflict, and gesture collision is
what I believe broke iOS Trade (F-BAR-12). This needs the deck
to own its gesture properly, and it needs a visible tap route
too — the dots alone are not an accessible affordance.

AND THE VETERAN'S POINT STANDS: Waiver Watch is a permanent
shrug today. Swiping to it changes nothing until F-BAR-04 is
wired. Content before chrome — the deck lands after the
widgets have something to say.

STILL OPEN

• Which widgets go in the deck, and in what order?
  Drawn here: League Pulse, Ledger, Waivers.
• Trade / Omen / League stay scoped to ONE team — the primary
  one. Confirm that is right when three are on screen.
• Off-season: no live scores until 2026-09-05. Every card here
  needs an honest pre-season state.
• Fewer than three teams: with one team, does the 'other teams'
  section disappear or invite you to connect another?

OPTION B — not chosen

Three equal cards, nobody primary. Truest to 'everything at a
glance', but the longest screen, and it breaks the 'one active
team' idea the context strip depends on.

OPTION C — not chosen for TEAMS

But its idea survived: the swipe moved to the widget deck on
the chosen direction. Kept here as the reference for how the
peek and dots should behave.
